title: Palindrome Linked List
desc:
給你一個單向鏈結串列的頭節點 head，請你判斷該串列是否為回文串列。如果是，返回 true；否則返回 false。

進階：你能否用 O(n) 時間複雜度和 O(1) 空間複雜度解決此題？

solutions.python:
# 方法一：反轉後半段（O(1) 空間，推薦）
class Solution:
    def isPalindrome(self, head: Optional[ListNode]) -> bool:
        if not head or not head.next:
            return True

        # 步驟 1：快慢指標找中點
        slow = fast = head
        while fast.next and fast.next.next:
            slow = slow.next
            fast = fast.next.next

        # 步驟 2：反轉後半段
        second = self.reverse(slow.next)

        # 步驟 3：比對前後半段
        p1, p2 = head, second
        result = True
        while p2:                     # 後半段較短，以它為準
            if p1.val != p2.val:
                result = False
                break
            p1 = p1.next
            p2 = p2.next

        # 步驟 4（好習慣）：把串列還原
        slow.next = self.reverse(second)
        return result

    def reverse(self, node):
        prev = None
        while node:
            nxt = node.next
            node.next = prev
            prev = node
            node = nxt
        return prev


# 方法二：複製到陣列（最簡單，O(n) 空間）
class Solution:
    def isPalindrome(self, head: Optional[ListNode]) -> bool:
        vals = []
        while head:
            vals.append(head.val)
            head = head.next
        return vals == vals[::-1]
